job_description:
Join Riverside Natural Foods Ltd., a Canadian-based, family-owned, and globally operating business, committed to leaving the world better than we found it. As a B-Corp certified, Triple-Bottom Line company, we proudly manufacture nutritious, 'better-for-you' snacks such as MadeGood and GOOD TO GO. We value teamwork, humility, respect, ownership, adaptability, grit, and fun.

We're on an ambitious mission to double our business by 2030, and we need talented individuals like you to help us reach new heights. At Riverside, you'll have the opportunity to chart your own path to success while contributing to ours. We believe anything worth doing is worth doing right, and our values will guide us through the rugged terrain – and yes, it will get rough. But that's what makes the journey worthwhile.

So, lace up your boots and let's tackle the climb together.

You can learn more about us at www.riversidenaturalfoods.com.

Position Summary:

A key aspect of our BT&T's mission is to build and sustain a capable organization for profitable growth; this entails deploying and driving adoption of leading practices as well as effectively leveraging SAP and other enterprise technology.
The Data Analyst

Intern is responsible for assisting in managing and maintaining the quality and integrity of all data. This role is crucial for ensuring that data related to business partners, customers, suppliers, and products is accurate and up-to-date.
The Data Analyst

Intern will also be responsible for assisting in the update and maintenance of POS and Distributor data to ensure it is current and accurate. This position will augment the bandwidth of our Master Data team.
Primary Responsibilities:

• Demonstrate and uphold Riverside Natural Food's Core Values

• Collaborate with MD Team to provide end-to-end technology solutions implementation and enablement.

• Data Maintenance: Assist in updating and maintaining master data to ensure accuracy, consistency and completeness

• Data Governance: Utilize data governance practices to consolidate, detect duplicates, and manage data quality.

• Data Quality Management: Continuously monitor and improve data quality through regular audits and remediation processes using MDG.

• Monitoring of MDG: Assist in monitoring change requests to make sure they are moving through the process in a timely manner

• Reporting: Generate and analyze reports on data quality and integrity

• Assist in POS and Distributor data management to ensure that it is current and accurate

• Support annual sales planning process and tools

• Special projects and other duties as assigned by the manager

• Collaborate effectively with key business decision makers and end users to resolve issues. Build strong working relationships with BPOs, Commercial team, Finance and Marketing

• Keeps the work atmosphere FUN by keeping it light and welcoming.

Reporting Relationships

• This position reports to the Manager of Enterprise Master Data & Analytics.

• This role will have no direct reports.

Qualifications

• Education:Post Secondary enrolment or a related field is required.

• Industry Knowledge: Understanding of the Food or CPG industry is preferred.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work both in a team environment and independently.

• Strong organizational, time management, facilitation, and process management skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

• PASSIONATE and has a desire to learn, roll-up their sleeves and set an example as a "doer"

• Ability to prioritize and multitask multiple projects at the same time

• Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment

• Exceptional time management and organizational skills, self-starter with a high level of initiative and ADAPTABILITY

• TEAM player with a positive attitude

• Demonstrates HUMILITY throughout the company on a daily basis

• Aptitude to exhibit, RESPECT and protect Riverside's Core Values in a changing environment

At Riverside, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation and job posting practices. The range above reflects the target compensation for the position at the time of posting. Exact compensation will be determined based on experience, skill set, education, and training, as well as other organizational needs, while balancing internal equity.
What we expect:

• Values-led: You'll be a member of a thoughtful and compassionate team that prioritizes respect, teamwork and resourcefulness along with a good dash of fun. Sometimes, even making granola bars is hard, and life's too short to take ourselves so seriously that we don't enjoy the journey.

• Unparalleled experiences and opportunities: We're still determining who we are and what we can be. Help us shape what this organization will look like and what we'll offer the world, into the future. This means rolling up your sleeves and sometimes building the process – fast! – while employing it. At Riverside, progress occasionally means proceeding imperfectly, and we're okay with that, as long as we're staying true to our values and learning and improving along the way.

• Access to everyone: We're a flat organization with few silos which means you'll have full access to everyone from our founders to our production staff. Even when employees dress up, they wear steel-toed shoes. So don't be shy. Speak up, share your ideas and go places you normally wouldn't – like the plant, or the boardroom.

• Personal development: We'll support and empower you to chart your own path and reach any heights you set for yourself. Career paths at Riverside are carved by the people walking on them, not dictated by leaders. Count on us to give you the training and tools to grow and progress.

• Gratitude: As a growing business, we can't always offer formal recognition like awards programs, but we do show our true gratitude and appreciation. At Riverside, we're all in this together and we value you.

• Be a Riverside Brand Ambassador: Stay relentlessly close to our consumers and represent the brand in every interaction, decision, and deliverable. Bring the consumer voice into your work by protecting product quality, availability, and experience, acting early when standards slip, and delivering consistent value that earns trust, advocacy, and long-term brand love.

What We Offer:

• Values-led: We don't cut corners or step on anyone or anything on our way to our summit. There is no winning at all costs here. Every step you take must align with our values, no compromises.

• Courageous determination: As a family-run, rapidly growing business, we are often challenged to find ways to deliver that aren't obvious or easy. You must be willing to try, ask and answer challenging questions, test and learn, turn over every stone, keep moving forward and help us find a way through. Resourcefulness and grit will be your constant companions at Riverside and will serve you well.

• Humility: We're a small (but growing) fish in a sea of whales and sharks. We know the products we offer are some of the healthiest and most sustainable, but we don't brag about it, and know we have a steep path ahead. We pride ourselves in being respectful and supportive of others while shining brightly through our innovative, high-quality products. There isn't one superstar at Riverside. We take turns leading the way as we climb to the summit.

• Continuous improvement: As a learn-as-we-go organization, we rely on each other to continuously improve everything we touch to make it better, more efficient, more sustainable, and more endearing to customers, consumers, employees, vendors, partners and the community. We own our mistakes and learn from them as we wind our way to the top.

Wait! There's more!

• Immerse yourself in our comprehensive benefits program, with Riverside taking care of the costs!

• RRSP matching or 401k matching for an empowered financial journey

• Eligibility to participate in Riverside's Profit Sharing Plan

• Join Employee-Led Resource Groups (ERGs) championing mental health, sustainability, diversity, women, and LGBTQ+ rights

• Develop your career further through our Riverside University program and with our Tuition Reimbursement Program

• An open concept work environment that embodies our Values

How to Apply:
If you have the commitment to excellence, the energy, the attitude and experience we need, then please submit your resume to careers(AT)riversidenaturals.com with the job title you are applying for in the subject line or click the apply button!
Riverside Natural Foods Ltd. is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you have a disability and require accommodation in the interview process, please let us know when you apply. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, due to volume, please note that only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Disclaimer: As part of our recruitment process, we may use technology-assisted tools, including automated systems, to support the review and assessment of applications. These tools do not make final hiring decisions. All decisions related to screening, interviewing, and selection are made by our Talent Acquisition and hiring teams.

Kodiak Robotics, Inc. was founded in 2018 and has become a leader in autonomous ground transportation committed to a safer and more efficient future for all. The company has developed an artificial intelligence (AI) powered technology stack purpose-built for commercial trucking and the public sector. The company delivers freight daily for its customers across the southern United States using its autonomous technology. In 2024, Kodiak became the first known company to publicly announce delivering a driverless semi-truck to a customer. Kodiak is also leveraging its commercial self-driving software to develop, test and deploy autonomous capabilities for the U.S. Department of Defense.

Data Engineering Intern
We are looking for a highly skilled Data Engineering Intern to join us and solve real-world robotics problems. Our ideal candidates exhibit a can-do attitude and approach their work with vigor and determination. Candidates will be expected to demonstrate excellence in their respective fields and possess the ability to learn quickly in a fast-paced environment.

In this role, you will:
• Optimize and maintain AuroraDB, ElasticSearch, and other data stores to ensure high availability, scalability, and performance for critical robotics and safety datasets.

• Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines to facilitate the continuous development of our data platform, ensuring data cleanliness, reliability, and efficient ingestion.

• Explore, evaluate, and scale QuickSight and modular dashboarding frameworks/factories to streamline reporting and surface actionable insights across the organization.

Qualifications:
• Pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative technical field.

• Strong working knowledge of relational and/or object database design, query optimization, and schema management.

• Experience or strong familiarity with cloud-based data platforms such as AWS Aurora DB and ElasticSearch, and building associated ETL/ELT pipelines.

• Familiarity with BI tools, dashboarding frameworks, or automated reporting factories (e.g., AWS QuickSight, Kibana, or custom visualization frameworks).

• Thinking with a safety mindset and an interest in autonomous systems or robotics.

• Ability to take ownership and enjoy working collaboratively to deliver dependable data solutions.

• Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and modern software development workflows.

Bonus Points:
• Hands-on internship or project experience building automated data pipelines or managing cloud database infrastructure.

• Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code or automated data integration frameworks.

Internship Program Details:
• Start Date: January 2027
• Our internship program is 12-16 weeks; the end date is flexible based on individual needs.
• Location: Mountain View, CA.
• Housing: Interns are responsible for housing.

What We Offer:
• A fast paced environment where we work with talented, committed and supportive teammates.
• Competitive pay.
• Excellent medical, dental and vision benefits.
• A beautiful facility in Mountain View.
• We love our dogs, so we are a dog friendly office!
• Free catered lunch.

The pay range listed below reflects the base salary in our SF/Silicon Valley location, across several internal levels. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors including: work location, experience, relevant training, education, skill level and performance during interview. Total compensation at Kodiak includes base pay, equity, bonus and a competitive benefits package

job_description:
Join Riverside Natural Foods Ltd., a Canadian-based, family-owned, and globally operating business, committed to leaving the world better than we found it. As a B-Corp certified, Triple-Bottom Line company, we proudly manufacture nutritious, 'better-for-you' snacks such as MadeGood and GOOD TO GO. We value teamwork, humility, respect, ownership, adaptability, grit, and fun.

We're on an ambitious mission to double our business by 2030, and we need talented individuals like you to help us reach new heights. At Riverside, you'll have the opportunity to chart your own path to success while contributing to ours. We believe anything worth doing is worth doing right, and our values will guide us through the rugged terrain – and yes, it will get rough. But that's what makes the journey worthwhile.

So, lace up your boots and let's tackle the climb together.

You can learn more about us at www.riversidenaturalfoods.com.

Position Summary:

A key aspect of our BT&T's mission is to build and sustain a capable organization for profitable growth; this entails deploying and driving adoption of leading practices as well as effectively leveraging SAP and other enterprise technology.
The Data Analyst

Intern is responsible for assisting in managing and maintaining the quality and integrity of all data. This role is crucial for ensuring that data related to business partners, customers, suppliers, and products is accurate and up-to-date.
The Data Analyst

Intern will also be responsible for assisting in the update and maintenance of POS and Distributor data to ensure it is current and accurate. This position will augment the bandwidth of our Master Data team.
Primary Responsibilities:

• Demonstrate and uphold Riverside Natural Food's Core Values

• Collaborate with MD Team to provide end-to-end technology solutions implementation and enablement.

• Data Maintenance: Assist in updating and maintaining master data to ensure accuracy, consistency and completeness

• Data Governance: Utilize data governance practices to consolidate, detect duplicates, and manage data quality.

• Data Quality Management: Continuously monitor and improve data quality through regular audits and remediation processes using MDG.

• Monitoring of MDG: Assist in monitoring change requests to make sure they are moving through the process in a timely manner

• Reporting: Generate and analyze reports on data quality and integrity

• Assist in POS and Distributor data management to ensure that it is current and accurate

• Support annual sales planning process and tools

• Special projects and other duties as assigned by the manager

• Collaborate effectively with key business decision makers and end users to resolve issues. Build strong working relationships with BPOs, Commercial team, Finance and Marketing

• Keeps the work atmosphere FUN by keeping it light and welcoming.

Reporting Relationships

• This position reports to the Manager of Enterprise Master Data & Analytics.

• This role will have no direct reports.

Qualifications

• Education:Post Secondary enrolment or a related field is required.

• Industry Knowledge: Understanding of the Food or CPG industry is preferred.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work both in a team environment and independently.

• Strong organizational, time management, facilitation, and process management skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

• PASSIONATE and has a desire to learn, roll-up their sleeves and set an example as a "doer"

• Ability to prioritize and multitask multiple projects at the same time

• Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment

• Exceptional time management and organizational skills, self-starter with a high level of initiative and ADAPTABILITY

• TEAM player with a positive attitude

• Demonstrates HUMILITY throughout the company on a daily basis

• Aptitude to exhibit, RESPECT and protect Riverside's Core Values in a changing environment

At Riverside, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation and job posting practices. The range above reflects the target compensation for the position at the time of posting. Exact compensation will be determined based on experience, skill set, education, and training, as well as other organizational needs, while balancing internal equity.
What we expect:

• Values-led: You'll be a member of a thoughtful and compassionate team that prioritizes respect, teamwork and resourcefulness along with a good dash of fun. Sometimes, even making granola bars is hard, and life's too short to take ourselves so seriously that we don't enjoy the journey.

• Unparalleled experiences and opportunities: We're still determining who we are and what we can be. Help us shape what this organization will look like and what we'll offer the world, into the future. This means rolling up your sleeves and sometimes building the process – fast! – while employing it. At Riverside, progress occasionally means proceeding imperfectly, and we're okay with that, as long as we're staying true to our values and learning and improving along the way.

• Access to everyone: We're a flat organization with few silos which means you'll have full access to everyone from our founders to our production staff. Even when employees dress up, they wear steel-toed shoes. So don't be shy. Speak up, share your ideas and go places you normally wouldn't – like the plant, or the boardroom.

• Personal development: We'll support and empower you to chart your own path and reach any heights you set for yourself. Career paths at Riverside are carved by the people walking on them, not dictated by leaders. Count on us to give you the training and tools to grow and progress.

• Gratitude: As a growing business, we can't always offer formal recognition like awards programs, but we do show our true gratitude and appreciation. At Riverside, we're all in this together and we value you.

• Be a Riverside Brand Ambassador: Stay relentlessly close to our consumers and represent the brand in every interaction, decision, and deliverable. Bring the consumer voice into your work by protecting product quality, availability, and experience, acting early when standards slip, and delivering consistent value that earns trust, advocacy, and long-term brand love.

What We Offer:

• Values-led: We don't cut corners or step on anyone or anything on our way to our summit. There is no winning at all costs here. Every step you take must align with our values, no compromises.

• Courageous determination: As a family-run, rapidly growing business, we are often challenged to find ways to deliver that aren't obvious or easy. You must be willing to try, ask and answer challenging questions, test and learn, turn over every stone, keep moving forward and help us find a way through. Resourcefulness and grit will be your constant companions at Riverside and will serve you well.

• Humility: We're a small (but growing) fish in a sea of whales and sharks. We know the products we offer are some of the healthiest and most sustainable, but we don't brag about it, and know we have a steep path ahead. We pride ourselves in being respectful and supportive of others while shining brightly through our innovative, high-quality products. There isn't one superstar at Riverside. We take turns leading the way as we climb to the summit.

• Continuous improvement: As a learn-as-we-go organization, we rely on each other to continuously improve everything we touch to make it better, more efficient, more sustainable, and more endearing to customers, consumers, employees, vendors, partners and the community. We own our mistakes and learn from them as we wind our way to the top.

Wait! There's more!

• Immerse yourself in our comprehensive benefits program, with Riverside taking care of the costs!

• RRSP matching or 401k matching for an empowered financial journey

• Eligibility to participate in Riverside's Profit Sharing Plan

• Join Employee-Led Resource Groups (ERGs) championing mental health, sustainability, diversity, women, and LGBTQ+ rights

• Develop your career further through our Riverside University program and with our Tuition Reimbursement Program

• An open concept work environment that embodies our Values

How to Apply:
If you have the commitment to excellence, the energy, the attitude and experience we need, then please submit your resume to careers(AT)riversidenaturals.com with the job title you are applying for in the subject line or click the apply button!
Riverside Natural Foods Ltd. is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you have a disability and require accommodation in the interview process, please let us know when you apply. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, due to volume, please note that only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

These tools do not make final hiring decisions. All decisions related to screening, interviewing, and selection are made by our Talent Acquisition and hiring teams.

At Riverside, you'll have the opportunity to chart your own path to success while contributing to ours. We believe anything worth doing is worth doing right, and our values will guide us through the rugged terrain – and yes, it will get rough. But that's what makes the journey worthwhile.

So, lace up your boots and let's tackle the climb together.

You can learn more about us at www.riversidenaturalfoods.com.

Position Summary:

A key aspect of our BT&T's mission is to build and sustain a capable organization for profitable growth; this entails deploying and driving adoption of leading practices as well as effectively leveraging SAP and other enterprise technology.
The Data Analyst

Intern is responsible for assisting in managing and maintaining the quality and integrity of all data. This role is crucial for ensuring that data related to business partners, customers, suppliers, and products is accurate and up-to-date.
The Data Analyst

Intern will also be responsible for assisting in the update and maintenance of POS and Distributor data to ensure it is current and accurate. This position will augment the bandwidth of our Master Data team.
Primary Responsibilities:

• Demonstrate and uphold Riverside Natural Food's Core Values

• Collaborate with MD Team to provide end-to-end technology solutions implementation and enablement.

• Data Maintenance: Assist in updating and maintaining master data to ensure accuracy, consistency and completeness

• Data Governance: Utilize data governance practices to consolidate, detect duplicates, and manage data quality.

• Data Quality Management: Continuously monitor and improve data quality through regular audits and remediation processes using MDG.

• Monitoring of MDG: Assist in monitoring change requests to make sure they are moving through the process in a timely manner

• Reporting: Generate and analyze reports on data quality and integrity

• Assist in POS and Distributor data management to ensure that it is current and accurate

• Support annual sales planning process and tools

• Special projects and other duties as assigned by the manager

• Collaborate effectively with key business decision makers and end users to resolve issues. Build strong working relationships with BPOs, Commercial team, Finance and Marketing

• Keeps the work atmosphere FUN by keeping it light and welcoming.

Reporting Relationships

• This position reports to the Manager of Enterprise Master Data & Analytics.

• This role will have no direct reports.

Qualifications

• Education:Post Secondary enrolment or a related field is required.

• Industry Knowledge: Understanding of the Food or CPG industry is preferred.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work both in a team environment and independently.

• Strong organizational, time management, facilitation, and process management skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

• PASSIONATE and has a desire to learn, roll-up their sleeves and set an example as a "doer"

• Ability to prioritize and multitask multiple projects at the same time

• Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment

• Exceptional time management and organizational skills, self-starter with a high level of initiative and ADAPTABILITY

• TEAM player with a positive attitude

• Demonstrates HUMILITY throughout the company on a daily basis

• Aptitude to exhibit, RESPECT and protect Riverside's Core Values in a changing environment

At Riverside, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation and job posting practices. The range above reflects the target compensation for the position at the time of posting. Exact compensation will be determined based on experience, skill set, education, and training, as well as other organizational needs, while balancing internal equity.
What we expect:

• Values-led: You'll be a member of a thoughtful and compassionate team that prioritizes respect, teamwork and resourcefulness along with a good dash of fun. Sometimes, even making granola bars is hard, and life's too short to take ourselves so seriously that we don't enjoy the journey.

• Unparalleled experiences and opportunities: We're still determining who we are and what we can be. Help us shape what this organization will look like and what we'll offer the world, into the future. This means rolling up your sleeves and sometimes building the process – fast! – while employing it. At Riverside, progress occasionally means proceeding imperfectly, and we're okay with that, as long as we're staying true to our values and learning and improving along the way.

• Access to everyone: We're a flat organization with few silos which means you'll have full access to everyone from our founders to our production staff. Even when employees dress up, they wear steel-toed shoes. So don't be shy. Speak up, share your ideas and go places you normally wouldn't – like the plant, or the boardroom.

• Personal development: We'll support and empower you to chart your own path and reach any heights you set for yourself. Career paths at Riverside are carved by the people walking on them, not dictated by leaders. Count on us to give you the training and tools to grow and progress.

• Gratitude: As a growing business, we can't always offer formal recognition like awards programs, but we do show our true gratitude and appreciation. At Riverside, we're all in this together and we value you.

• Be a Riverside Brand Ambassador: Stay relentlessly close to our consumers and represent the brand in every interaction, decision, and deliverable. Bring the consumer voice into your work by protecting product quality, availability, and experience, acting early when standards slip, and delivering consistent value that earns trust, advocacy, and long-term brand love.

What We Offer:

• Values-led: We don't cut corners or step on anyone or anything on our way to our summit. There is no winning at all costs here. Every step you take must align with our values, no compromises.

• Courageous determination: As a family-run, rapidly growing business, we are often challenged to find ways to deliver that aren't obvious or easy. You must be willing to try, ask and answer challenging questions, test and learn, turn over every stone, keep moving forward and help us find a way through. Resourcefulness and grit will be your constant companions at Riverside and will serve you well.

• Humility: We're a small (but growing) fish in a sea of whales and sharks. We know the products we offer are some of the healthiest and most sustainable, but we don't brag about it, and know we have a steep path ahead. We pride ourselves in being respectful and supportive of others while shining brightly through our innovative, high-quality products. There isn't one superstar at Riverside. We take turns leading the way as we climb to the summit.

• Continuous improvement: As a learn-as-we-go organization, we rely on each other to continuously improve everything we touch to make it better, more efficient, more sustainable, and more endearing to customers, consumers, employees, vendors, partners and the community. We own our mistakes and learn from them as we wind our way to the top.

Wait! There's more!

• Immerse yourself in our comprehensive benefits program, with Riverside taking care of the costs!

• RRSP matching or 401k matching for an empowered financial journey

• Eligibility to participate in Riverside's Profit Sharing Plan

• Join Employee-Led Resource Groups (ERGs) championing mental health, sustainability, diversity, women, and LGBTQ+ rights

• Develop your career further through our Riverside University program and with our Tuition Reimbursement Program

• An open concept work environment that embodies our Values

If you have the commitment to excellence, the energy, the attitude and experience we need, then please submit your resume to careers(AT)riversidenaturals.com with the job title you are applying for in the subject line or click the apply button!

job_description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst & Workflow Associate Consultant, Corporate Legal Solutions based in Canada.
This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of legal operations, technology, and digital transformation.

You will help corporate legal teams identify inefficiencies and turn complex processes into streamlined, automated workflows.

The role combines business analysis, consulting, workflow design, testing, and client engagement.

You will work directly with enterprise clients, translating business needs into practical technology solutions.

As part of a small, collaborative consulting team, you will have meaningful ownership while learning from experienced professionals.

The environment is fast-paced and remote-first, with opportunities to work alongside legal, technology, and engineering specialists.

It is an ideal role for an analytical, proactive problem-solver who wants to help shape the future of legal technology.

Accountabilities

• Conduct client interviews, research, and process observations to identify opportunities for automation and operational improvement.

• Create process maps, workflow diagrams, requirements documents, and solution designs that translate business needs into optimized processes.

• Design, build, configure, and test automated workflows using no-code and low-code platforms.

• Troubleshoot workflow issues, refine existing solutions, and adapt configurations as user and business requirements evolve.

• Act as a voice for end users, helping ensure solutions are intuitive, efficient, and aligned with customer expectations.

• Provide first-line support to business and legal users working with contract lifecycle management and legal AI platforms.

• Support data-quality activities, reporting, testing, system administration, and other operational needs.

• Facilitate workshops, client presentations, discovery sessions, and real-time problem-solving discussions.

• Manage assigned project responsibilities, monitoring timelines, scope, and budget to support successful delivery.

• Prepare client-facing reports, proposals, presentations, and supporting technical or process documentation.

• Collaborate with engineers, developers, legal professionals, and other cross-functional stakeholders to deliver effective solutions.

• Build expertise in legal technology, workflow automation, system integrations, and emerging trends while identifying opportunities for innovation.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of consulting methodologies, tools, and best practices.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Legal Studies, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

• At least 3 years of experience in consulting, legal operations, business analysis, process automation, or a related field.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, particularly when working with business processes, systems, and operational challenges.

• Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and effectively in both written and verbal formats.

• Experience creating process documentation, workflow diagrams, requirements, and solution specifications.

• Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, system configurations, or workflow solutions.

• Proficiency with productivity and documentation tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, or Lucidchart.

• Strong technical aptitude and willingness to learn and work with no-code and low-code workflow platforms.

• Entrepreneurial, adaptable, and proactive mindset, with the ability to take ownership in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated leadership through academic, professional, extracurricular, or community experiences.

• Comfortable working collaboratively in a remote-first environment with distributed teams and enterprise clients.

• A genuine interest in legal technology, legal operations, enterprise workflow automation, and digital transformation.

• Experience working with legal departments or related business functions is a plus.

• Familiarity with platforms such as TAP, ServiceNow, Onit, Checkbox, Airtable, Malbek, or Tonkean is an advantage.

• Relevant internship or early-stage startup experience is desirable.

Benefits

• Opportunity to work on innovative legal technology and workflow automation projects with enterprise clients.

• Exposure to corporate legal departments, legal operations, automation, and digital transformation.

• Collaborative, remote-first working environment.

• Mentorship and guidance from experienced consultants and senior leaders.

• Opportunity to develop expertise across no-code/low-code platforms, workflow design, and legal technology.

• Meaningful ownership of client engagements and opportunities to contribute to a high-growth technology consulting environment.

• Equal opportunity workplace committed to diversity, inclusion, and fair consideration of qualified candidates.

How Jobgether Works

AI-powered matching process

Kodiak is also leveraging its commercial self-driving software to develop, test and deploy autonomous capabilities for the U.S. Department of Defense.

Data Engineering Intern
We are looking for a highly skilled Data Engineering Intern to join us and solve real-world robotics problems. • Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines to facilitate the continuous development of our data platform, ensuring data cleanliness, reliability, and efficient ingestion.

• Explore, evaluate, and scale QuickSight and modular dashboarding frameworks/factories to streamline reporting and surface actionable insights across the organization.

Qualifications:
• Pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative technical field.

• Strong working knowledge of relational and/or object database design, query optimization, and schema management.

As a B-Corp certified, Triple-Bottom Line company, we proudly manufacture nutritious, 'better-for-you' snacks such as MadeGood and GOOD TO GO. We value teamwork, humility, respect, ownership, adaptability, grit, and fun.

We're on an ambitious mission to double our business by 2030, and we need talented individuals like you to help us reach new heights. At Riverside, you'll have the opportunity to chart your own path to success while contributing to ours. We believe anything worth doing is worth doing right, and our values will guide us through the rugged terrain – and yes, it will get rough. But that's what makes the journey worthwhile.

So, lace up your boots and let's tackle the climb together.

You can learn more about us at www.riversidenaturalfoods.com.

Position Summary:

A key aspect of our BT&T's mission is to build and sustain a capable organization for profitable growth; this entails deploying and driving adoption of leading practices as well as effectively leveraging SAP and other enterprise technology.
The Data Analyst

Intern is responsible for assisting in managing and maintaining the quality and integrity of all data. This role is crucial for ensuring that data related to business partners, customers, suppliers, and products is accurate and up-to-date.
The Data Analyst

Intern will also be responsible for assisting in the update and maintenance of POS and Distributor data to ensure it is current and accurate. This position will augment the bandwidth of our Master Data team.
Primary Responsibilities:

• Demonstrate and uphold Riverside Natural Food's Core Values

• Collaborate with MD Team to provide end-to-end technology solutions implementation and enablement.

• Data Maintenance: Assist in updating and maintaining master data to ensure accuracy, consistency and completeness

• Data Governance: Utilize data governance practices to consolidate, detect duplicates, and manage data quality.

• Data Quality Management: Continuously monitor and improve data quality through regular audits and remediation processes using MDG.

• Monitoring of MDG: Assist in monitoring change requests to make sure they are moving through the process in a timely manner

• Reporting: Generate and analyze reports on data quality and integrity

• Assist in POS and Distributor data management to ensure that it is current and accurate

• Support annual sales planning process and tools

• Special projects and other duties as assigned by the manager

• Collaborate effectively with key business decision makers and end users to resolve issues. Build strong working relationships with BPOs, Commercial team, Finance and Marketing

• Keeps the work atmosphere FUN by keeping it light and welcoming.

Reporting Relationships

• This position reports to the Manager of Enterprise Master Data & Analytics.

• This role will have no direct reports.

Qualifications

• Education:Post Secondary enrolment or a related field is required.

• Industry Knowledge: Understanding of the Food or CPG industry is preferred.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work both in a team environment and independently.

• Strong organizational, time management, facilitation, and process management skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

• PASSIONATE and has a desire to learn, roll-up their sleeves and set an example as a "doer"

• Ability to prioritize and multitask multiple projects at the same time

• Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment

• Exceptional time management and organizational skills, self-starter with a high level of initiative and ADAPTABILITY

• TEAM player with a positive attitude

• Demonstrates HUMILITY throughout the company on a daily basis

• Aptitude to exhibit, RESPECT and protect Riverside's Core Values in a changing environment

At Riverside, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation and job posting practices. The range above reflects the target compensation for the position at the time of posting. Exact compensation will be determined based on experience, skill set, education, and training, as well as other organizational needs, while balancing internal equity.
What we expect:

• Values-led: You'll be a member of a thoughtful and compassionate team that prioritizes respect, teamwork and resourcefulness along with a good dash of fun. Sometimes, even making granola bars is hard, and life's too short to take ourselves so seriously that we don't enjoy the journey.

• Unparalleled experiences and opportunities: We're still determining who we are and what we can be. Help us shape what this organization will look like and what we'll offer the world, into the future. This means rolling up your sleeves and sometimes building the process – fast! – while employing it. At Riverside, progress occasionally means proceeding imperfectly, and we're okay with that, as long as we're staying true to our values and learning and improving along the way.

• Access to everyone: We're a flat organization with few silos which means you'll have full access to everyone from our founders to our production staff. Even when employees dress up, they wear steel-toed shoes. So don't be shy. Speak up, share your ideas and go places you normally wouldn't – like the plant, or the boardroom.

• Personal development: We'll support and empower you to chart your own path and reach any heights you set for yourself. Career paths at Riverside are carved by the people walking on them, not dictated by leaders. Count on us to give you the training and tools to grow and progress.

• Gratitude: As a growing business, we can't always offer formal recognition like awards programs, but we do show our true gratitude and appreciation. At Riverside, we're all in this together and we value you.

• Be a Riverside Brand Ambassador: Stay relentlessly close to our consumers and represent the brand in every interaction, decision, and deliverable. Bring the consumer voice into your work by protecting product quality, availability, and experience, acting early when standards slip, and delivering consistent value that earns trust, advocacy, and long-term brand love.

What We Offer:

• Values-led: We don't cut corners or step on anyone or anything on our way to our summit. There is no winning at all costs here. Every step you take must align with our values, no compromises.

• Courageous determination: As a family-run, rapidly growing business, we are often challenged to find ways to deliver that aren't obvious or easy. You must be willing to try, ask and answer challenging questions, test and learn, turn over every stone, keep moving forward and help us find a way through. Resourcefulness and grit will be your constant companions at Riverside and will serve you well.

• Humility: We're a small (but growing) fish in a sea of whales and sharks. We know the products we offer are some of the healthiest and most sustainable, but we don't brag about it, and know we have a steep path ahead. We pride ourselves in being respectful and supportive of others while shining brightly through our innovative, high-quality products. There isn't one superstar at Riverside. We take turns leading the way as we climb to the summit.

• Continuous improvement: As a learn-as-we-go organization, we rely on each other to continuously improve everything we touch to make it better, more efficient, more sustainable, and more endearing to customers, consumers, employees, vendors, partners and the community. We own our mistakes and learn from them as we wind our way to the top.

Wait! There's more!

• Immerse yourself in our comprehensive benefits program, with Riverside taking care of the costs!

• RRSP matching or 401k matching for an empowered financial journey

• Eligibility to participate in Riverside's Profit Sharing Plan

• Join Employee-Led Resource Groups (ERGs) championing mental health, sustainability, diversity, women, and LGBTQ+ rights

• Develop your career further through our Riverside University program and with our Tuition Reimbursement Program

• An open concept work environment that embodies our Values

How to Apply:
If you have the commitment to excellence, the energy, the attitude and experience we need, then please submit your resume to careers(AT)riversidenaturals.com with the job title you are applying for in the subject line or click the apply button!
Riverside Natural Foods Ltd. is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you have a disability and require accommodation in the interview process, please let us know when you apply. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, due to volume, please note that only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Disclaimer: As part of our recruitment process, we may use technology-assisted tools, including automated systems, to support the review and assessment of applications. These tools do not make final hiring decisions. All decisions related to screening, interviewing, and selection are made by our Talent Acquisition and hiring teams.

job_description:
Business Data Analyst – AI Services (must be fluent in German and English)
Company
Terzo is an Enterprise AI Data and Analytics platform that ‘makes data dance’! We believe that data can transform financial and operating performance by driving better decision-making.
Terzo uses the latest in artificial intelligence technologies to automate data processing and advanced analytics. Our platform structures unstructured data, setting it free to enrich corporate data lakes and power our analytics. Terzo's solutions help customers transform procurement, drive strategic and tail spend cost reduction, improve IT asset management, increase organic revenue growth, manage complex obligations and compliance in supply chains, budget and forecast, support financial audit, and more.

O pportunity
The AI-Services team serves as the backbone of Terzo by enabling our customers to capture insights on document data that is critical to their business. This position offers qualified candidates the opportunity to learn and work with cutting-edge AI technologies that service some of the largest companies in the world through one of the most innovative startups in the space. The work includes contributing to AI model training and quality assurance, as well as managing daily and weekly tasks to meet demanding customer deadlines.

The ideal candidate should be enthusiastic about doing high-quality analytical work in a collaborative team-first manner and should be comfortable in a fast-paced high-energy environment. We are searching for motivated individuals who are looking to build their careers in the technology industry through a rapidly growing organization. Terzo fosters the growth mindset and is looking for individuals who want to work, learn, and grow by providing superior work product to our customers.

Roles & Responsibilities
In the role, the Business Data Analyst will become familiar with AI technology and how the technology is shaping the enterprise workplace. Through completion of daily and weekly tasks and projects, the Business Data Analyst will also gain in-depth exposure to unstructured data sources across the enterprise and how improvement of these data sources through systemic data processing can improve business performance.
Terzo’s Business Data Analyst role offers the right candidate a three-year development path, which can lead to positions of greater responsibility, professional growth, and development areas that can contribute to early career and personal development. The ideal candidate should be enthusiastic about doing high-quality analytical work in a collaborative team-first culture. Candidates should be comfortable in a fast-paced high-energy startup environment. We are searching for motivated individuals looking to start their careers in the technology industry through a rapidly growing organization.

• Uncover and Leverage Key Insights from Complex Documents Dive deep into essential data embedded in documents to drive actionable insights and strategic decisions.

• Identify Customer Challenges and Develop Tailored Strategic Solutions for Significant Business Impact

• Investigate unique customer challenges to design and implement bespoke solutions that drive transformative business results and deliver substantial value.

• Transform Customer Documents into Powerful Terzo Reports and Dashboards Analyze critical data from customer documents and seamlessly integrate it into Terzo's cutting-edge reports and dashboards.

• Craft and Execute Strategic Project Plans to Achieve Customer Objectives Design and implement innovative project plans and strategies tailored to surpass customer goals and drive success.

• Spot and Resolve Data Discrepancies with Precision Identify and rectify data inconsistencies with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and reliability.

• Lead Data-Intensive Special Projects with Expertise Tackle high-impact special projects requiring sophisticated data analysis, delivering valuable insights and outcomes.

• Harness Terzo’s Advanced AI and SaaS Technology for Cutting-Edge Solutions Collaborate with Terzo’s state-of-the-art AI and SaaS technologies to innovate and optimize processes that enable advanced data foundations for our customers

• Orchestrate and Oversee Records of Activities, Tasks, and Timelines Manage and streamline records of activities, tasks, and deadlines to ensure flawless execution and efficiency.

Success Criteria
• Must be speak fluent English and German

• Analytical and problem-solving skills

• Self-motivated, attentive to detail, desire to learn, work hard, and grow your career

• Proficiency in computer applications such as MS Office, including spreadsheets

• Ability to read and understand business documents and spreadsheets

• Ability to work and communicate effectively with team members

• College-level knowledge of correct spelling, grammar, and punctuation in the English language and French language (a third European language is a plus)

• Must be able to work in-office in Montreal, QC between 8 am-5 pm, Monday-Friday

• Must have reliable transportation (public transportation is acceptable) and be able to get to Montreal, QC (free parking provided)

• Working vocabulary in business, financial, accounting, and legal terms is a plus

• The most common background for this role is a bachelor’s degree in business, economics, pre-law, education, psychology, or a social sciences field that develop business reading, writing, and critical thinking skills

job_description:
Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Are you a creative problem-solver who is energized by challenges? You've come to the right place.

YOUR IMPACT

You'll work in teams of typically 3 - 5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of the client engagement.

This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations. You'll also present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members.

You'll gain new skills and build on the strengths you bring to the firm. You will receive exceptional training as well as frequent coaching and mentoring from colleagues on their teams. Additionally, you'll receive guidance and support from your local office in the selection of client projects, helping you to develop your skills and build your network.

You will join as a business analyst intern in our Paris office and will be part of McKinsey Tech & AI for 6 months to be a part of our client teams. You will get first-hand experience with consulting at McKinsey. At the end of the internship, you may receive an offer to join us as a full-time Business Analyst after graduation.

As part of this group, you'll join a global team working on everything from IT modernization and strategy to agile, cloud, cybersecurity, and digital transformation. You'll typically work on projects across all industries and functions and will be fully integrated with the rest of our global firm. You'll also work with colleagues from across McKinsey & Company to help our clients deliver breakthrough products, experiences, and businesses, both on technology and non-technology topics.

you are joining a firm whose culture is distinctive and inclusive. We will accelerate your development as a leader to create positive, enduring change in the world. In this role you will work on the best teams to help the best organizations in the world - in private, public, and social sectors - solve their most difficult problems. You will also work with many experts, from data scientists and researchers to software and app designers.

Tech & AI at McKinsey brings together the best of Tech & AI capabilities to help our clients use digital technology and assets to transform their businesses. As part of this group, you'll join a global team working on everything related to digital strategy/transformation, IT modernization, Agile scaling, digital marketing, etc.

YOUR GROWTH

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues-at all levels-will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won't find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

• Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
• A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You'll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
• Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm's diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you'll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
• World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

• Currently enrolled in a Master Grande Ecole, Master of Engineering or MSc program in computer science, telecommunications, or other engineering/technical related field preferred
• Outstanding record of academic achievement
• Demonstrated aptitude for analytics
• Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities
• Strong record of initiative-taking and leadership in a work setting and/or extracurricular activities
• Resourceful, intellectually curious, high energy and mature
• Fluent level language skills in French and English

Please review the additional requirements regarding essential job functions of McKinsey colleagues.

Our unwavering commitment to integrity drives everything we do, guiding us to always act in the best interests of our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.

Gift Administration & Data Specialist

Location: Downtown Toronto, ON

Work Model: Hybrid

Position Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical and collaborative Gift Administration & Data Specialist to join a high-performing team at our downtown Toronto office.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with fundraising data, financial information, donor records and process improvement and who takes pride in accuracy and data integrity.

Reporting to the Gift Administration leadership team, you will be responsible for the setup, processing, reconciliation and reporting of pre-authorized recurring donations received through multiple offline fundraising channels, including Direct Mail, Telemarketing and Face-to-Face campaigns.

You will work extensively with Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge, donor and financial data, internal teams and external vendors to ensure donations are accurately processed, reconciled and receipted.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with large volumes of data, and interested in using automation and AI tools to improve processes and reduce manual work.

Key Responsibilities

Gift Processing & Data Management
• Process recurring and pre-authorized donations received through Direct Mail, Telemarketing, Face-to-Face and other fundraising channels.
• Download and process encrypted vendor files and accurately enter and update donor and gift information.
• Manage the end-to-end processing of monthly recurring gifts, including make-up payments, pauses, cancellations and account updates.
• Perform quality checks and reconcile vendor data, Raiser’s Edge records and financial information.
• Investigate and resolve discrepancies between fundraising data, Raiser’s Edge and bank records.
• Create and maintain import templates for Raiser’s Edge using the Raiser’s Edge Import module and/or Import-O-Matic.
• Process staff payroll contributions in Raiser’s Edge based on information provided by Payroll.
• Complete daily reconciliation of recurring gifts and third-party designated donations.

Gift Receipting & CRA Compliance
• Issue accurate CRA-compliant tax receipts, cancelled receipts, replacement receipts and ad hoc receipts.
• Prepare consolidated annual tax receipt data files for donors.
• Ensure gift processing and revenue allocation comply with CRA requirements, organizational policies and established procedures.
• Maintain a high level of confidentiality and integrity when handling donor and financial information.

Reporting & Analysis
• Prepare scheduled and ad hoc reports on recurring donations, revenue activity and trends.
• Provide accurate reporting and status updates to internal teams and management.
• Analyze fundraising and financial data to identify discrepancies, trends and opportunities for improvement.
• Work with Marketing & Development and other internal stakeholders to support new campaign launches and ongoing campaign requirements.

Process Improvement, Automation & AI
• Identify inefficiencies, redundancies and potential sources of error within gift administration processes.
• Recommend and implement process improvements that increase accuracy and efficiency.
• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive data and gift-processing activities.
• Utilize AI tools to summarize documentation, identify patterns and flag inconsistencies across systems.
• Develop or support automation workflows using Python, Power Automate, Zapier or similar tools.
• Contribute to modernization initiatives within Gift Administration.

Procedures, Documentation & Training
• Maintain and update the Data Entry Guide, Gift Entry Manual, PAP Manual and End-to-End Procedures.
• Develop new procedures and documentation as processes evolve.
• Maintain and update policies, procedures and guidelines related to recurring gifts.
• Provide training and guidance to staff involved in recurring gift processing and receipting.
• Share recommendations for improving processes beyond recurring gift administration.

Team & Organizational Support
• Collaborate with and support the broader Gift Administration team.
• Provide backup support for online gifts, major gifts, gift administration and receipting when required.
• Assist with volunteers, temporary staff and interns as needed.
• Support the annual financial audit and Annual Charities Return preparation.
• Participate in special projects and other duties assigned by Gift Administration leadership or the CFO.

Qualifications & Experience
• Post-secondary education in finance, accounting, fundraising, business, data management or a related field.
• Approximately 2–3 years of relevant experience in gift administration, fundraising operations, financial administration, data management or a related environment.
• Experience with Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge or another non-profit fundraising database.
• Experience with Import-O-Matic or similar data-import/integration tools is an asset.
• Strong understanding of CRA charitable gift receipting requirements.
• Strong Excel and data analysis skills; experience with Power BI is an asset.
• Strong understanding of fundraising and/or accounting processes and procedures.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint.
• Basic programming or automation experience using Python, JavaScript, Power Automate, Zapier or similar tools is an asset.

What We're Looking For

The successful candidate will demonstrate:
• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
• Excellent organization and time-management skills
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a team
• Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills
• Adaptability and willingness to learn new systems and processes
• A proactive approach to identifying and solving problems
• Interest in technology, automation and continuous process improvement

Why Join?

Join a people-focused organization recognized as a Great Place to Work, where learning, collaboration and professional growth are valued.

You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of fundraising, finance, data and technology, while contributing directly to the integrity and efficiency of donor administration and revenue processing.

Location: Downtown Toronto

Work Model: Hybrid

Candidates must be eligible to work in Canada

Role: Agile Business Analyst Location: Canada (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Work Authorization: Canadian Citizen / Permanent Resident (PR) / Valid Canadian Work Permit Pay Rate: CAD $85,000 – $100,000 per year Travel: Not Required

Who Should Apply: # Systems Analysts, Functional Analysts, Requirements Analysts, Process Analysts, Business Process Analysts, Product Analysts, Project Analysts, PMO Analysts, Agile Coordinators, Scrum Coordinators, Project Coordinators, Program Coordinators, Implementation Coordinators, Agile Business Analysts, Business Analysts, Junior Business Analysts, Business Systems Analysts etc and others.

# Professionals returning to the workforce # Individuals from diverse backgrounds

Job Description

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Agile Business Analyst to support requirements gathering, business process analysis, user story development and Agile delivery initiatives. You will work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, development teams, QA teams, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into clear functional requirements and support successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

Gather, analyze and document business and functional requirements. Translate business needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria. Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, developers, QA teams and stakeholders. Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives. Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for improvement. Support backlog management, prioritization and requirement clarification. Create process flows, functional specifications, business documentation and user guides. Assist with User Acceptance Testing (UAT), test planning and defect tracking. Monitor requirements and deliverables throughout the project lifecycle. Identify business gaps, dependencies, risks and issues and assist with resolution. Prepare project updates, reports and stakeholder documentation.

job_title: Co-Op Student - Data Engineer, AI Readiness (Medical-Legal Data)
job_description:
■ CO-OP STUDENT — DATA ENGINEER, AI READINESS (MEDICAL-LEGAL DATA)

(Fully Remote - Ontario or Quebec)

CONTRIBUTING TO THE CMPA

The Student, Data Engineer, AI Readiness will help transform raw, largely unstructured medical-legal records into governed, high-quality data assets that can be used safely and reliably for AI development and evaluation. This is not a one-time data-cleanup role: the student will help establish reusable data foundations that support CMPA’s broader AI roadmap. This placement offers a rare opportunity to see how disciplined data engineering—including data quality, traceability, privacy protection, and documentation—affects the reliability and auditability of AI systems in a regulated, high-stakes environment.

POSITION OVERVIEW

CMPA's AI & Advanced Analytics team builds AI solutions that process sensitive medical-legal content. We are looking for a co-op student to focus on transforming raw medical-legal data into AI-ready datasets: cleaned, standardized, labeled, and governed so they can reliably train, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models. This role works entirely with internally hosted data and infrastructure (on-prem GPU servers) to maintain strict privacy and security for PHI/PII, and supports real production pipelines already in active development.

You will gain hands-on experience designing data pipelines and quality controls for sensitive, unstructured information; applying privacy and governance principles in practice; and contributing to AI capabilities that are being developed for real organizational use. You will work closely with experienced AI, data, privacy, and domain professionals.

POSITION ACTIVITIES
• Clean, normalize, and structure raw text from call transcripts, internal documents, and case files into standardized, machine-consumable formats.
• Help define and apply AI-readiness criteria for medical-legal datasets — completeness, consistency, labeling accuracy, lineage, and auditability — so data quality becomes measurable rather than assumed.
• Develop Python scripts and lightweight data pipelines for ingesting, de-identifying, chunking, formatting, and validating documents at scale, with traceability suitable for audit review.
• Create and maintain evaluation/test sets (e.g., scripted advisor-member conversation samples) to benchmark transcription, summarization, and classification performance.
• Document data preparation standards, labeling guidelines, and known data quality issues so the process is repeatable, governed, and auditable across teams.
• Work closely with the AI program lead to align data preparation work with governance, privacy, and security requirements for regulated healthcare data.
• Support document classification and medical-legal coding workflows by preparing labeled datasets and validating tagging accuracy against existing coding schemes.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
• Currently enrolled in a co-op program in Computer Science, Data Science, Health Informatics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• Foundational Python programming skills, including experience working with structured or unstructured data. Experience with libraries such as pandas, regular expressions, spaCy, or similar is an asset.
• Familiarity with core NLP or document-processing concepts—such as text normalization, tokenization, named-entity recognition, classification, or information extraction—through coursework, personal projects, research, or prior work.
• Ability to work methodically with ambiguous, incomplete, and messy real-world data.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES
• Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and comfort handling sensitive or high-stakes information in accordance with established procedures.
• Ability to document data transformations, assumptions, validation steps, and known limitations clearly and consistently.
• Strong written communication and an ability to collaborate remotely with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Exposure to healthcare, legal, insurance, public-sector, or other regulated-domain data is an asset.
• Familiarity with privacy-preserving data practices, including de-identification or anonymization of PHI/PII is an asset.
• Exposure to data quality, data lineage, metadata, data governance, audit, privacy, security, or compliance concepts is an asset.
• Experience with data annotation, labeling tools, building labeling workflows, or evaluating label quality is an asset.
• Exposure to speech-to-text, document OCR, document parsing, or text-extraction pipelines is an asset.
• Experience working in a Linux, Git, Jupyter, SQL, or API-based development environment is an asset.

POSTING DETAILS
• Job type: This is a Temporary Full-Time position from January 2027 to April 2027 with possibility for a 4 month extension
• This position is for an existing vacancy
• Salary range: Between $22.00-$26.00/hour based on level of education and previous relevant work experience.
• Location: Fully Remote Job, working from a home-based office anywhere in the provinces of Ontario and Québec.
• Students are defined as individuals who are enrolled in full-time studies at a post-secondary institution during the year that they are employed. To be considered for a position, candidates must be enrolled in an academic program from January 2027 to April 2027
• Skills assessment: Selected candidates may be required to complete a skill assessment
• Application deadline: October 9, 2026 at 4:00PM EST

job_description:
• CO-OP STUDENT — DATA ENGINEER, AI READINESS (MEDICAL-LEGAL DATA)

(Fully Remote - Ontario or Quebec)
CONTRIBUTING TO THE CMPA The Student, Data Engineer, AI Readiness will help transform raw, largely unstructured medical-legal records into governed, high-quality data assets that can be used safely and reliably for AI development and evaluation. This is not a one-time data-cleanup role: the student will help establish reusable data foundations that support CMPA’s broader AI roadmap. This placement offers a rare opportunity to see how disciplined data engineering—including data quality, traceability, privacy protection, and documentation—affects the reliability and auditability of AI systems in a regulated, high-stakes environment.
POSITION OVERVIEW

CMPA's AI & Advanced Analytics team builds AI solutions that process sensitive medical-legal content. We are looking for a co-op student to focus on transforming raw medical-legal data into AI-ready datasets: cleaned, standardized, labeled, and governed so they can reliably train, fine-tune, and evaluate AI models. This role works entirely with internally hosted data and infrastructure (on-prem GPU servers) to maintain strict privacy and security for PHI/PII, and supports real production pipelines already in active development.
You will gain hands-on experience designing data pipelines and quality controls for sensitive, unstructured information; applying privacy and governance principles in practice; and contributing to AI capabilities that are being developed for real organizational use. You will work closely with experienced AI, data, privacy, and domain professionals.

POSITION ACTIVITIES

• Clean, normalize, and structure raw text from call transcripts, internal documents, and case files into standardized, machine-consumable formats.

• Help define and apply AI-readiness criteria for medical-legal datasets — completeness, consistency, labeling accuracy, lineage, and auditability — so data quality becomes measurable rather than assumed.

• Develop Python scripts and lightweight data pipelines for ingesting, de-identifying, chunking, formatting, and validating documents at scale, with traceability suitable for audit review.

• Create and maintain evaluation/test sets (e.g., scripted advisor-member conversation samples) to benchmark transcription, summarization, and classification performance.

• Document data preparation standards, labeling guidelines, and known data quality issues so the process is repeatable, governed, and auditable across teams.

• Work closely with the AI program lead to align data preparation work with governance, privacy, and security requirements for regulated healthcare data.

• Support document classification and medical-legal coding workflows by preparing labeled datasets and validating tagging accuracy against existing coding schemes.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Currently enrolled in a co-op program in Computer Science, Data Science, Health Informatics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Foundational Python programming skills, including experience working with structured or unstructured data. Experience with libraries such as pandas, regular expressions, spaCy, or similar is an asset.

• Familiarity with core NLP or document-processing concepts—such as text normalization, tokenization, named-entity recognition, classification, or information extraction—through coursework, personal projects, research, or prior work.

• Ability to work methodically with ambiguous, incomplete, and messy real-world data.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES

• Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and comfort handling sensitive or high-stakes information in accordance with established procedures.

• Ability to document data transformations, assumptions, validation steps, and known limitations clearly and consistently.

• Strong written communication and an ability to collaborate remotely with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Exposure to healthcare, legal, insurance, public-sector, or other regulated-domain data is an asset.

• Familiarity with privacy-preserving data practices, including de-identification or anonymization of PHI/PII is an asset.

• Exposure to data quality, data lineage, metadata, data governance, audit, privacy, security, or compliance concepts is an asset.

• Experience with data annotation, labeling tools, building labeling workflows, or evaluating label quality is an asset.

• Exposure to speech-to-text, document OCR, document parsing, or text-extraction pipelines is an asset.

• Experience working in a Linux, Git, Jupyter, SQL, or API-based development environment is an asset.

job_title: Data Analyst Intern - SUMMER 2025 (3-months) at Electronic Arts Canada
job_description:
Data Analyst Intern - SUMMER 2025 (3-months) job at Electronic Arts. Canada.

We exist to Inspire the World to Play. We create extraordinary new game experiences for our millions of players everywhere by bringing together talented people that combine creativity, innovation, and passion. We immerse our employees into an inclusive culture and provide opportunities for learning and leading that allow our employees to do the most impactful and rewarding work of their careers.

Join us in driving the next revolution in games.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst Intern to join our world-class paid internship experience. The start date for this opportunity is May 2025 (3-month term).

You will report to the Senior Security Software Engineer II in the SPEAR (Secure Product Engineering & Anti-Cheat Response) Automation team, part of EA Security. You’ll be working closely with the SPEAR Automation team, helping to uncover and present actionable insights that will shape security strategies for our game studios and partner teams. Your work will provide critical support to EA’s CISO and other security stakeholders, turning raw data into meaningful information that enhances decision-making.
Responsibilities
• Analyse data generated from our source code security scanning platform and deliver insights to help game studios and the security team understand security trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
• Collaborate with the security team to produce dashboards, reports, and metrics that answer key security questions from senior leaders and other stakeholders.
• Identify patterns, trends, and anomalies within data sets that will drive actionable recommendations.
• Assist in the design and implementation of data models that improve how data is structured, stored, and utilised for reporting purposes.
• Partner with development and security teams to ensure data from different sources is gathered, cleansed, and analysed effectively.
Requirements
• Pursuing a degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
• Proficiency with data analysis tools and languages, such as SQL, Python, R, or equivalent.
• Strong understanding of statistical analysis and data visualisation techniques.
• Familiarity with security concepts or a willingness to quickly learn about the world of source code security and vulnerability scanning.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate data insights into clear, actionable recommendations.
• We are only considering students mid-way through their college career, slated to graduate no earlier than December 2025. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the US on a full time basis during the 12-week internship. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
Desirable
• Experience with business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
• Familiarity with working with large data sets and cleaning/manipulating data.
• Understanding of API usage and integration for data extraction.
• Interest in cyber security and the tech industry.

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
